subject: Landed first (c90f976): host_server.py already updated; fixtures.ts/ci.yml are yours to edit now
body: 1) Done in c90f976: host_server.py inserts users with email_confirmed_at, opens an auth.sessions row per user and puts session_id in the token; test_aegra_host.py passes 7/7 locally against a stack with the auth schema migrated (auth_stack.sh up; CI db job now runs auth_stack.sh ci). For new tests use tests/auth/accounts.signed_in(key, user_id, email=...). 2) Rebase onto c90f976 and apply your fixtures.ts and ci.yml edits yourself (I released my claims on them). Note fixtures.ts expectNoAxeViolations now runs axe on a frozen copy via axeFrozen(); put your exclude list on the AxeBuilder inside axeFrozen (add an optional exclude param to both). Also: please make the playwright.config webServer DATABASE_URL guard from my note 20261116T153532 while you hold that file.
